# Mira Purkrábek

> Goes by Mira; publishes and is credited academically as Miroslav Purkrábek.

Computer vision researcher and engineer. PhD candidate at CTU Prague (Visual Recognition
Group, advisor: prof. Jiří Matas), currently a research intern at Qualcomm XR Labs, Amsterdam
(June–December 2026).

## Key facts

- First-author papers at CVPR 2025 (ProbPose) and ICCV 2025 (BBox-Mask-Pose), on robust human
  pose estimation and segmentation.
- 1st place and $5,000, S23DR structured-3D-reconstruction challenge, CVPR 2026 (with Jan
  Skvrna).
- Built FACIS, a forensic image/video analysis system commissioned by the Ministry of the
  Interior for the Czech Police's Criminal Police Service — now in active use.
- Two years as a software developer at Porsche Engineering (2020–2022): control-unit software
  for the Porsche Taycan (170,000+ delivered worldwide, 2020–2025) and software across the
  components of Porsche's High Power Charging platform.
- Eight years coaching floorball (2017–2025), including head coach of a Czech Superliga men's
  team.
